title: The scalar counit equation for the transported composite chart
statement:
Fix a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ and a prime $\ell\ne p$. All schemes are separated of finite type over $k$, and all maps are $k$-morphisms [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a unital homomorphism of finite commutative rings killed by powers of $\ell$, and choose $N=\ell^n\geq1$ annihilating both. On either the ordinary etale or pro-etale site let $\mathcal C_{T,R}=D^b_{ctf}(T,R)$ mean the full category of constant-$R$ module complexes with bounded constructible cohomology and finite Tor amplitude: tensor with any degree-zero module sheaf has cohomology in one fixed finite interval [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf, def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude, det-sp-et-proet-adjunction-transfer]. Write $T_T=-\otimes^L_{A_T}B_T$ [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor, lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. The finite Tate line is $R_T(1)=\mu_{N,T}\otimes_{(\mathbf Z/N)_T}R_T$ on the etale site and its comparison inverse image on the pro-etale site; $(d)$ denotes tensor with its $d$th tensor power [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist].
Let $e:U\to\mathbf A^d_Y$ be separated etale of finite type, $g=p_de$, and choose standing compactifications. Use $F^{et}_{g,R}\dashv H^{et}_{g,R}$ and $F^{pro}_{g,R}\dashv H^{pro}_{g,R}$ with their specified sum-then-ordered-affine counits as constructed in [lem-sp-chart-finite-ring-adjunction], for $R=A,B$. On either site the natural isomorphism
$$a_{g,K}:T_UH_{g,A}K\xrightarrow{\sim}H_{g,B}T_YK$$
is the canonical derived tensor/pullback, shift and Tate identification [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback, det-sp-scalar-extension-functor]; on the Tate line it sends $(z\otimes a)\otimes b$ to $z\otimes\varphi(a)b$. Let $\beta_g$ on the etale site and $b_g$ on the pro-etale site be the specified compact-support coefficient maps [lem-sp-et-proet-coefficient-compatibility]. For every $K\in\mathcal C_{Y,A}$, the actual composite chart counits satisfy
$$\epsilon^{et}_{g,B,T_YK}\circ F^{et}_{g,B}(a_{g,K})\circ\beta_g(H^{et}_{g,A}K)=T_Y(\epsilon^{et}_{g,A,K}),$$
and
$$\widetilde\epsilon_{g,B,T_YK}\circ F^{pro}_{g,B}(a_{g,K})\circ b_g(H^{pro}_{g,A}K)=T_Y(\widetilde\epsilon_{g,A,K}).$$
These equations use the specified fixed-compactification maps and remain true after canonical refinement identifications. They concern the explicit chart right functor and its counit, without assuming an exceptional coefficient comparison invertible or choosing any smooth orientation.
